tips.text: Tranq it first, then kite Infested to the sleeping animal and go invisible or into Void mode so they attack it; it flees and despawns if it sees you.
Never damage it yourself; your own damage never weakens it, and a modded weapon kills a lured Predasite outright.
If kiting fails, throw a Pherliac Pod on the tranquilized Predasite so Infested pile onto it; the parts drop from Juggernauts.
Use a Predasite Echo-Lure and Pheromone Glands from Son to summon one on demand if none spawn.
Skip bullet-jump slams and stray fire during bounties; a dead target is gone.
Donate spare Weakened Viziers at rank 30 to fund gilding without extra Conservation.
Donate pets before you hit the daily standing cap; Son refuses a pet donation once you are capped.
Players say the Vizier itself is easy to catch; the friction is Entrati standing and the fish parts for the Mutagen and Antigen.
